mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_audit_log (actor_id, actor_role, action_type, resource_type, resource_ref, document_id, result_code, trace_id, detail_json) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{log.actorIdHex, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{log.actorRole, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.actionType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.resourceType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.resourceRef, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HEXTORAW(#{log.documentIdHex, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{log.resultCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.traceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{log.detailJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON))
mapper.select:
SELECT RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS "id", TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(a.occurred_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' AS "occurredAt", u.display_name AS "actor", u.username AS "actorAccount", a.actor_role AS "actorRole", a.action_type AS "actionType", a.resource_type AS "resourceType", a.resource_ref AS "resourceRef", a.result_code AS "resultCode", a.trace_id AS "traceId", a.source_ip AS "sourceIp", a.user_agent AS "userAgent", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_audit_log f WHERE f.actor_id = a.actor_id AND f.result_code NOT IN ('200', 'SUCCESS') AND f.occurred_at >= #{since}) AS "failCount" FROM edudoc_audit_log a LEFT JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC, RAWTOHEX(a.id) DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_audit_log a LEFT JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = a.actor_id

SELECT RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS "id", TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(a.occurred_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' AS "occurredAt", u.display_name AS "actor", u.username AS "actorAccount", a.actor_role AS "actorRole", a.action_type AS "actionType", a.resource_type AS "resourceType", a.resource_ref AS "resourceRef", a.result_code AS "resultCode", a.trace_id AS "traceId", a.source_ip AS "sourceIp", a.user_agent AS "userAgent", RAWTOHEX(a.document_id) AS "documentId", d.title AS "documentTitle", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_audit_log f WHERE f.actor_id = a.actor_id AND f.result_code NOT IN ('200', 'SUCCESS') AND f.occurred_at BETWEEN a.occurred_at - NUMTODSINTERVAL(24, 'HOUR') AND a.occurred_at) AS "failCount" FROM edudoc_audit_log a LEFT JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = a.actor_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_document d ON d.id = a.document_id WHERE a.id = HEXTORAW(#{eventId})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS "id", TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(a.occurred_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' AS "occurredAt", a.action_type AS "actionType", a.resource_type AS "resourceType", a.resource_ref AS "resourceRef", a.result_code AS "resultCode" FROM edudoc_audit_log a WHERE a.trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY a.occurred_at ASC, RAWTOHEX(a.id) ASC
